• Tempus to build a de-identified dataset from hundreds of thousands of patients with neurological conditions; Pathos to license the dataset under a five-year, $55 million agreement
  • Pathos’s AI expertise and agentic AI platform, Foundry, combined with Bristol Myers Squibb’s (BMS) neuroscience drug development expertise to be applied to understanding disease progression and advancing new therapies
  • BMS leads Pathos’s Series E financing and gains non-exclusive strategic access to Pathos’s AI platform, Pathos Foundry, across its broader portfolio, along with three-year exclusive rights to support its neuroscience development programs

NEW YORK, October 23, 2026 — Pathos AI, a clinical-stage AI and technology company advancing its own therapeutic pipeline, today announced multi-year strategic collaborations with Bristol Myers Squibb (NYSE: BMY, “BMS”) and Tempus AI, Inc. (NASDAQ: TEM, “Tempus”) to build a specialized, curated dataset and agentic AI capabilities for Alzheimer’s disease and other neurological conditions. BMS also leads Pathos’s Series E financing and gains access to Pathos Foundry across its broader R&D portfolio.

Tempus will apply the infrastructure and expertise it has built in oncology to create a comprehensive, de-identified, longitudinal dataset from hundreds of thousands of patients with neurological conditions, designed to track outcomes over time and accelerate biological insight. Pathos will license the data from Tempus under a five-year, $55 million agreement.

Pathos will apply its AI platform, Pathos Foundry, to interrogate the dataset at scale, generate and test hypotheses on disease biology, and inform the design of more targeted, adaptive clinical trials. Pathos built and validated this approach in oncology, where it guides decisions across the company’s clinical-stage pipeline, including adapting trial design in real time to improve its projected probability of success.

The collaboration builds on BMS's broader strategy to combine advanced AI with deep scientific and disease-area expertise to make faster, higher-confidence decisions that drive innovation for patients. BMS is helping expand the application of Pathos Foundry into neuroscience, securing three-year exclusive rights in an area where the company brings deep research, clinical-development expertise and a growing portfolio of programs in Alzheimer’s disease and other neurological conditions. Through multi-year access to the platform across its broader portfolio and the specialized dataset developed through the definitive agreements, BMS aims to generate deeper insights into disease progression, identify patients most likely to benefit from potential therapies and design more precise clinical trials.

“Neurological diseases demand more than any one company can bring on its own: the best longitudinal data, AI that can reason over it at scale, and the drug development expertise to turn insight into medicines,” said Iker Huerga, CEO of Pathos AI. “Intelligence alone does not bring a therapy to market. These collaborations bring all three together. We are thrilled to deepen our work with Tempus and proud to have BMS leading our Series E as we build a self-learning drug development system designed to adapt clinical trials and improve the likelihood of success.”

“AI has the greatest potential when it is grounded in high-quality data and applied by scientists with deep understanding of diseases and drug development,” said Simon Davies, SVP, Head of Data and Quantitative Sciences, Bristol Myers Squibb. “Our investment in Pathos reflects our commitment to applying advanced AI and data science across research and development to accelerate innovation for patients. By combining AI-driven insights with our neuroscience expertise, we hope to deepen our understanding of disease progression, improve clinical-trial design and ultimately advance new treatment options. Collaborating with Pathos and Tempus allows us to interrogate Alzheimer’s and other neurological diseases at scale, strengthening our pipeline and advancing precision medicine for patients in need.”

“Making meaningful progress against a disease as devastating as Alzheimer’s requires unprecedented data scale and computing power,” said Eric Lefkofsky, Founder and CEO of Tempus. “These collaborations unite BMS’s deep expertise, Pathos’s drug development agentic AI and Tempus’ data infrastructure. Together, we have a unique opportunity to uncover novel insights and accelerate much-needed treatments for Alzheimer’s patients.”

About Pathos AI

Pathos AI is an AI and technology company developing drugs. The company redesigns drug development from first principles: identifying clinical assets, making portfolio decisions with continuously updated probability-of-success calculations, and guiding clinical trials with AI-native monitoring. Pathos’s pipeline includes clinical-stage programs in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer, multiple myeloma, MET-altered non-small-cell lung cancer, ER+/HER2‐ breast cancer, and TROP2/HER3-expressing solid tumors. The company is based in New York City. For more information, visit pathos.com.

translation.html:
• Tempus 将基于数十万名神经系统疾病患者的数据构建去标识化数据集；Pathos 将根据一项为期五年、价值 5500 万美元的协议获得该数据集的使用许可
  • Pathos 的 AI 专业能力及其智能体 AI 平台 Foundry 将与百时美施贵宝（BMS）在神经科学药物开发方面的专业能力相结合，用于理解疾病进展并推动新疗法开发
  • BMS 领投 Pathos 的 E 轮融资，并获得在其更广泛的产品组合中使用 Pathos AI 平台 Pathos Foundry 的非独家战略性访问权，以及支持其神经科学开发项目的三年独家使用权

纽约，2026 年 10 月 23 日——Pathos AI 是一家推进自有治疗产品管线的临床阶段 AI 与技术公司。该公司今日宣布与百时美施贵宝（纽约证券交易所代码：BMY，简称“BMS”）及 Tempus AI, Inc.（纳斯达克代码：TEM，简称“Tempus”）开展多年战略合作，为阿尔茨海默病及其他神经系统疾病构建经过专门整理的数据集和智能体 AI 能力。BMS 还领投了 Pathos 的 E 轮融资，并获得在其更广泛的研发产品组合中使用 Pathos Foundry 的权限。

Tempus 将运用其在肿瘤学领域建立的基础设施和专业能力，基于数十万名神经系统疾病患者的数据，创建一个全面、去标识化的纵向数据集，旨在随时间追踪结局，并加快获得生物学洞见。Pathos 将根据一项为期五年、价值 5500 万美元的协议，从 Tempus 获得该数据集的使用许可。

Pathos 将运用其 AI 平台 Pathos Foundry，对该数据集开展大规模深入分析，提出并检验有关疾病生物学的假设，并为更具针对性的适应性临床试验设计提供依据。Pathos 已在肿瘤学领域建立并验证了这一方法，用于指导公司整个临床阶段产品管线的决策，包括实时调整试验设计，以提高其预测成功概率。

此次合作建立在 BMS 更广泛的战略之上，即将先进 AI 与深厚的科学及疾病领域专业知识相结合，更快地作出更有把握的决策，为患者推动创新。BMS 正在帮助将 Pathos Foundry 的应用拓展至神经科学领域，并获得该领域的三年独家使用权。公司在这一领域拥有深厚的研究和临床开发专业能力，以及不断扩大的阿尔茨海默病及其他神经系统疾病项目组合。通过获得在其更广泛的产品组合中多年使用该平台的权限，以及通过正式协议开发的专门数据集，BMS 旨在更深入地理解疾病进展，识别最有可能从潜在疗法中获益的患者，并设计更精准的临床试验。

Pathos AI 首席执行官 Iker Huerga 表示：“应对神经系统疾病所需的能力，超出了任何一家公司独力所能提供的范围：最优质的纵向数据、能够基于这些数据进行大规模推理的 AI，以及将洞见转化为药物的药物开发专业能力。仅凭智能无法让一种疗法上市。这些合作将三者汇聚在一起。我们很高兴深化与 Tempus 的合作，也很荣幸由 BMS 领投我们的 E 轮融资。我们正在构建一个能够自我学习的药物开发系统，旨在调整临床试验并提高成功的可能性。”

百时美施贵宝高级副总裁兼数据与定量科学负责人 Simon Davies 表示：“当 AI 以高质量数据为基础，并由深刻理解疾病和药物开发的科学家加以运用时，它最能发挥潜力。我们对 Pathos 的投资，体现了我们致力于将先进 AI 和数据科学应用于整个研发过程、为患者加快创新的承诺。通过将 AI 驱动的洞见与我们的神经科学专业能力相结合，我们希望深化对疾病进展的理解，改进临床试验设计，并最终推动新的治疗选择。与 Pathos 和 Tempus 合作，使我们能够大规模深入研究阿尔茨海默病及其他神经系统疾病，增强我们的产品管线，并为有需要的患者推进精准医疗。”

Tempus 创始人兼首席执行官 Eric Lefkofsky 表示：“要在应对阿尔茨海默病这样具有毁灭性影响的疾病方面取得实质性进展，需要前所未有的数据规模和计算能力。这些合作汇聚了 BMS 深厚的专业能力、Pathos 用于药物开发的智能体 AI，以及 Tempus 的数据基础设施。携手合作，我们拥有独特的机会，可以发现新的洞见，并加快为阿尔茨海默病患者开发亟需的治疗方法。”

关于 Pathos AI

Pathos AI 是一家从事药物开发的 AI 与技术公司。公司从第一性原理出发重新设计药物开发流程：识别临床阶段药物资产，通过持续更新的成功概率计算作出产品组合决策，并通过 AI 原生监测指导临床试验。Pathos 的产品管线包括针对转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌、多发性骨髓瘤、MET 改变型非小细胞肺癌、ER+/HER2‐ 乳腺癌及表达 TROP2/HER3 的实体瘤的临床阶段项目。公司总部位于纽约市。更多信息，请访问 pathos.com。
